_comment: Items that do the same job under a different name, so no variant mapping links them. A tag that lists an item also lists these, so a player who owns one sees it in the tab. RuneLite cannot put them in the original's layout slot; they land in the next free one. Same-name variants ((l), (i), (or), broken, charged, recolours) need no entry: the tag accepts those already. Upgrades with different stats (Avernic defender, Abyssal tentacle, Masori assembler over Ava's assembler) do not belong here. Every name must resolve on the wiki, or validation fails.

equivalents.reason: A STASH unit takes ten nails of any one metal except dragon.
